Summary: This update removes the redundant skill-card.md file and clarifies functionality in documentation.

- Removed skill-card.md file for simplicity and to avoid duplication.
- Updated documentation to clarify supported features, including video analytics and content generation.
- No changes to API endpoints or core skill behavior.

Initial release of Reelyze skill: an AI analyst for short-form video (Reels, TikTok, Shorts).

- Analyze any Instagram Reel, TikTok, or YouTube Short by URL to get frame-by-frame drop-off points and improvement suggestions.
- Call the Reelyze API for four tools: video transcript, MP4 download, MP3 audio extraction (free, metered), or full AI performance analysis (paid).
- Supports polling async jobs and provides structured responses (transcript, download link, audio, or AI report).
- Requires a Reelyze API key (rk_live_...) set as an environment variable.
- Useful for creators, managers, or brands aiming to boost video retention and effectiveness.
